result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

args.text:
MEMO - March 2026 close: AP inbox catch-up (five unentered March vendor bills)
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com (senior accountant) | Date: 2026-04-03

BACKGROUND
Per DOC-0211 (email from Priya, AP, 2026-04-01), five March vendor bills reached the AP inbox and were never entered. All five are billed to Halvard Systems Inc. (US, USD). I confirmed none of them existed in the ledger (vendor-name searches returned no entries) and none were paid in March (all Net 30; no matching March bank activity in DOC-0209 / US unmatched bank lines). All five were therefore recorded as open AP (2000) at 3/31.

ENTRIES POSTED (all US, period 2026-03, support attached to each)

1. JE-00304 - Quillon Analytics QA-4471, 3/9, USD 2,180.00
   Dr 6200 Software Subscriptions 2,180.00 / Cr 2000 AP 2,180.00
   March-2026 analytics platform subscription; service period is March, fully expensed. Support: DOC-0178, DOC-0211.

2. JE-00305 - Cirrus CDN CC-20260312, 3/12, USD 7,940.55
   Dr 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure 7,940.55 / Cr 2000 AP 7,940.55
   March CDN/edge-delivery usage - infrastructure cost of delivering the service, consistent with other hosting vendors. Support: DOC-0183, DOC-0211.

3. JE-00306 - Whitcombe & Ames LLP WA-3318, 3/20, USD 3,475.00
   Dr 6500 Legal Fees 3,475.00 / Cr 2000 AP 3,475.00
   Commercial contract review performed in March; service received in period. Support: DOC-0194, DOC-0211.

4. JE-00307 - Delmar Insurance DI-99120, 3/1, USD 9,600.00
   Dr 1220 Prepaid Insurance 8,800.00; Dr 6700 Insurance 800.00 / Cr 2000 AP 9,600.00
   D&O annual premium covering 2026-03-01 to 2027-02-28. Policy 4 (prepaids >USD 1,000 spanning more than one month): capitalized and amortized straight-line over 12 months beginning March, the month coverage begins. March expense = 9,600 / 12 = 800.00; prepaid balance carried at 3/31 = 8,800.00 (11 months remaining). Support: DOC-0147, DOC-0211, DOC-0005.

5. JE-00308 - Meridian Events ME-0612, 3/24, USD 4,200.00
   Dr 1200 Prepaid Expenses 4,200.00 / Cr 2000 AP 4,200.00
   Exhibitor booth deposit for DataWorld Expo, June 9-11, 2026. Policy 4 explicitly treats deposits for future events above USD 1,000 as prepaid, expensed when the event occurs. No P&L impact in March; release to 6320/6400 in June 2026 when the event takes place. Support: DOC-0198, DOC-0211, DOC-0005.

IMPACT
- AP (2000, US) increased USD 27,395.55; March ending balance USD 123,695.55 (credit).
- March P&L impact USD 14,395.55 (6200 2,180.00; 5000 7,940.55; 6500 3,475.00; 6700 800.00).
- Balance sheet: 1220 Prepaid Insurance +8,800.00; 1200 Prepaid Expenses +4,200.00.
- Two prepaid amortization streams to carry forward on the schedule: Delmar D&O 800.00/month April 2026 through February 2027; Meridian booth 4,200.00 one-time release in June 2026.

APPROVALS / POLICY
Each entry is below the USD 10,000 senior-accountant posting threshold (largest is Delmar at 9,600.00), so no controller approval request was required under policy 1. The Delmar bill was booked as a single entry (prepaid plus the first month's amortization) rather than split, consistent with the anti-splitting provision. Every entry carries the underlying vendor bill as support per policy 2.

EXCEPTIONS
None. All five bills were fully supported by vendor invoices in the document store; no items required flag_exception.

CHECKLIST
US "AP cutoff review" set to in_progress - the five AP-inbox bills are now booked, but the item is not marked complete because a full cutoff review (search for other goods/services received in March but not yet invoiced, and accrual of those under policy 5) is still outstanding and is separate from this request.
